Alphabetical  Jigsaw  (of  a  kind) The  letter  according  to  which  each  clue  is  listed  is  not  necessarily  the  initial letter  of  the  solution,  but  is  the  consonant  or  vowel,  as  the  case  may  be, which  occurs  more  than  any  other  in  the  solution.  Thus  OCCASION  could be  clued  under  O  or  C,  whereas  OCCASIONALLY  could  not  be  used  at  all, since  it  has  as  many  As  as  Os  and  Ls  as  Cs.
